DOCUMENT:
TITLE: Operation WHITE STRIKE: NCB Busts Major Cocaine Syndicate in Mumbai Region seizing 349 kg High-Grade Cocaine worth an Estimated Value ₹1,745 Crore
DATE: 01 May 2026
SOURCE: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Home Affairs
SOURCE_TYPE: GOVERNMENT_PRESS_RELEASE
RELEASE_ID: 2257339
LOCATION: PIB Delhi

CASE:
NAME: Operation WHITE STRIKE
TYPE: DRUG_TRAFFICKING_INVESTIGATION
STATUS: ACTIVE_INVESTIGATION
DESCRIPTION: NCB operation that uncovered a large transnational cocaine trafficking syndicate and seized approximately 349 kilograms of high-grade cocaine valued at nearly ₹1,745 crore in the illicit market.

ORGANIZATION:
NAME: Narcotics Control Bureau
ROLE: INVESTIGATING_AGENCY
STATUS: CONDUCTED_OPERATION

LOCATION:
NAME: Mumbai
TYPE: CITY
DESCRIPTION: Mumbai region where the cocaine trafficking syndicate was uncovered and where the first-stage seizure occurred.

LOCATION:
NAME: Kalamboli
TYPE: AREA
DESCRIPTION: Location in the Navi Mumbai-Thane region where the vehicle was intercepted.

LOCATION:
NAME: KWC Warehousing Complex
TYPE: WAREHOUSE_COMPLEX
DESCRIPTION: Sector KWC, Kalamboli, Navi Mumbai; location where the Maruti Suzuki Super Carry was intercepted.

LOCATION:
NAME: Navi Mumbai
TYPE: CITY_REGION
DESCRIPTION: Part of the Navi Mumbai-Thane region where the first strike occurred.

LOCATION:
NAME: Bhiwandi
TYPE: CITY
DESCRIPTION: Major warehousing hub in District Thane where the second consignment was found.

LOCATION:
NAME: Laxman Compound
TYPE: AREA
DESCRIPTION: Location of the warehouse where the second operation was conducted.

NAME: Rehnal Bus Stand
TYPE: LANDMARK

LOCATION:
NAME: Rehnal Gaon

LOCATION:
NAME: District Thane
TYPE: DISTRICT
DESCRIPTION: District containing Bhiwandi.

DRUG:
NAME: Cocaine
TYPE: HIGH_GRADE_COCAINE
QUANTITY: Approximately 349 kg
VALUE: Nearly ₹1,745 crore
STATUS: SEIZED

VEHICLE:
NAME: Maruti Suzuki Super Carry
TYPE: CNG_VEHICLE
REGISTRATION: MH-03-DV-3803
STATUS: INTERCEPTED

SEIZURE:
DRUG: Cocaine
QUANTITY: Approximately 349 kg
VALUE: Nearly ₹1,745 crore
LOCATION: Mumbai and adjoining logistics corridor
DESCRIPTION: Approximately 349 kg of high-grade cocaine was seized in a two-stage operation. The first strike recovered 136 packets of approximately 1 kg each. The second operation recovered an additional 213 packets of approximately 1 kg each.

SEIZURE:
DRUG: Cocaine
QUANTITY: 136 packets, approximately 1 kg each
LOCATION: KWC Warehousing Complex, Sector KWC, Kalamboli, Navi Mumbai
DESCRIPTION: Cocaine recovered from cartons concealed using cricket pads and gloves inside a Maruti Suzuki Super Carry.

SEIZURE:
DRUG: Cocaine
QUANTITY: 213 packets, approximately 1 kg each
LOCATION: Warehouse at Laxman Compound near Rehnal Bus Stand, Rehnal Gaon, Bhiwandi, District Thane
DESCRIPTION: Additional cocaine consignment recovered during the second operation.

EVENT:
TYPE: DRUG_SEIZURE
DATE: 01 May 2026
LOCATION: Mumbai region
DESCRIPTION: NCB seized approximately 349 kg of high-grade cocaine valued at nearly ₹1,745 crore as part of Operation WHITE STRIKE.

EVENT:
TYPE: VEHICLE_INTERCEPTION
LOCATION: KWC Warehousing Complex, Sector KWC, Kalamboli, Navi Mumbai
DESCRIPTION: NCB officers intercepted a Maruti Suzuki Super Carry CNG vehicle bearing registration MH-03-DV-3803.

EVENT:
TYPE: ARREST
STATUS: ONE_ACCUSED_APPREHENDED
LOCATION: KWC Warehousing Complex, Sector KWC, Kalamboli, Navi Mumbai
DESCRIPTION: One accused was apprehended on the spot after the vehicle containing concealed cocaine was searched.
NOTE: The government press release does not provide the accused person's name.

EVENT:
TYPE: SECOND_OPERATION
LOCATION: Laxman Compound near Rehnal Bus Stand, Rehnal Gaon, Bhiwandi, District Thane
DESCRIPTION: NCB conducted a second operation at a warehouse and recovered an additional 213 packets of cocaine, approximately 1 kg each.

EVENT:
TYPE: INTELLIGENCE_INVESTIGATION
DURATION: More than six months
ORGANIZATION: Narcotics Control Bureau
DESCRIPTION: The operation followed more than six months of sustained intelligence development and surveillance by NCB.

EVENT:
TYPE: INVESTIGATION
STATUS: ONGOING
DESCRIPTION: Preliminary investigation revealed cocaine concealed inside a machine cavity imported into India. The release states that the contraband was packed in nine layers of different types of polythene, including one layer of black greasy substance.

EVENT:
TYPE: INVESTIGATION
STATUS: ONGOING
DESCRIPTION: Intensive investigation is underway to apprehend the kingpin, handlers, financiers, and intended receivers of the consignment.

TEXT: The press release states that the syndicate is transnational and organised, but it does not provide a specific organisation name. No organisation name has been invented.

TEXT: The figures 136 packets and 213 packets correspond to the two stages of the operation and together account for 349 packets of approximately 1 kg each.
